Settings.QueryText: SELECT DocumentMessage.Ref AS Ref, DocumentMessage.DeletionMark AS DeletionMark, DocumentMessage.Number AS Number, DocumentMessage.Date AS Date, DocumentMessage.Posted AS Posted, DocumentMessage.ActivityEndTime AS ActivityEndTime, DocumentMessage.ActivityStartTime AS ActivityStartTime, DocumentMessage.Author AS Author, DocumentMessage.B24TaskID AS B24TaskID, DocumentMessage.ByObject AS ByObject, DocumentMessage.ByOrder AS ByOrder, DocumentMessage.ClosedBy AS ClosedBy, DocumentMessage.CloseToDate AS CloseToDate, DocumentMessage.Color AS Color, DocumentMessage.ColorHexString AS ColorHexString, DocumentMessage.ContactPerson AS ContactPerson, DocumentMessage.DateWhenClosed AS DateWhenClosed, DocumentMessage.EMail AS EMail, DocumentMessage.ForDepartment AS ForDepartment, DocumentMessage.ForEmployee AS ForEmployee, DocumentMessage.Hotel AS Hotel, DocumentMessage.IsClosed AS IsClosed, DocumentMessage.MessageStatus AS MessageStatus, DocumentMessage.MessageType AS MessageType, DocumentMessage.ParentDoc AS ParentDoc, DocumentMessage.Phone AS Phone, DocumentMessage.Phone2 AS Phone2, DocumentMessage.PopUp AS PopUp, DocumentMessage.Position AS Position, DocumentMessage.Remarks AS Remarks, DocumentMessage.ReservationTaskArea AS ReservationTaskArea, DocumentMessage.SendBySMS AS SendBySMS, DocumentMessage.SMSIsSent AS SMSIsSent, DocumentMessage.Type AS Type, DocumentMessage.ValidFromDate AS ValidFromDate, DocumentMessage.ValidToDate AS ValidToDate, DocumentMessage.PointInTime AS PointInTime, CASE WHEN DocumentMessage.CloseToDate <> &qEmptyDate AND DocumentMessage.CloseToDate < &qCurrentDate THEN 32 WHEN DocumentMessage.CloseToDate <> &qEmptyDate AND &qNumberOfDaysToWarnBeforeExpire > 0 AND DocumentMessage.CloseToDate <= DATEADD(&qCurrentDate, DAY, &qNumberOfDaysToWarnBeforeExpire) THEN 31 ELSE 0 END AS IsExpired FROM Document.Message AS DocumentMessage WHERE DocumentMessage.Date BETWEEN &qDateFrom AND &qDateTo AND (DocumentMessage.Hotel = &qHotel OR NOT &qHotelIsFilled) AND (DocumentMessage.Type = &qType OR NOT &qTypeIsFilled) AND (DocumentMessage.MessageStatus = &qStatus OR NOT &qStatusIsFilled) AND (DocumentMessage.MessageType = &qMessageType OR NOT &qMessageTypeIsFilled) AND (DocumentMessage.ByObject = &qByObject OR NOT &qByObjectIsFilled) AND (DocumentMessage.ByObject IN HIERARCHY (&qRoom) AND DocumentMessage.ByObject REFS Catalog.Rooms OR NOT &qRoomIsFilled) AND (DocumentMessage.ByObject IN HIERARCHY (&qResource) AND DocumentMessage.ByObject REFS Catalog.Resources OR NOT &qResourceIsFilled) AND (DocumentMessage.ByObject IN HIERARCHY (&qCustomer) AND DocumentMessage.ByObject REFS Catalog.Customers OR NOT &qCustomerIsFilled) AND (DocumentMessage.ContactPerson = &qContactPerson OR NOT &qContactPersonIsFilled) AND (DocumentMessage.Author IN HIERARCHY (&qAuthor) OR NOT &qAuthorIsFilled) AND (DocumentMessage.ClosedBy IN HIERARCHY (&qClosedBy) OR NOT &qClosedByIsFilled) AND (DocumentMessage.ByObject = &qGuestGroup AND DocumentMessage.ByObject REFS Catalog.GuestGroups OR NOT &qGuestGroupIsFilled) AND (DocumentMessage.ForEmployee IN HIERARCHY (&qEmployee) OR NOT &qEmployeeIsFilled OR DocumentMessage.Ref IN (SELECT ForEmployeesMessages.Ref FROM Document.Message.ForEmployees AS ForEmployeesMessages WHERE ForEmployeesMessages.Ref.Date BETWEEN &qDateFrom AND &qDateTo AND (ForEmployeesMessages.Ref.Hotel = &qHotel OR NOT &qHotelIsFilled) AND ForEmployeesMessages.Employee IN HIERARCHY (&qEmployee))) AND (DocumentMessage.ForDepartment IN HIERARCHY (&qDepartment) OR NOT &qDepartmentIsFilled OR DocumentMessage.Ref IN (SELECT ForDepartmentsMessages.Ref FROM Document.Message.ForDepartments AS ForDepartmentsMessages WHERE ForDepartmentsMessages.Ref.Date BETWEEN &qDateFrom AND &qDateTo AND (ForDepartmentsMessages.Ref.Hotel = &qHotel OR NOT &qHotelIsFilled) AND ForDepartmentsMessages.Department IN HIERARCHY (&qDepartment))) AND (&qShowClosed OR NOT &qShowClosed AND NOT DocumentMessage.DeletionMark AND NOT DocumentMessage.IsClosed) AND (NOT &qShowPopUpOnly OR &qShowPopUpOnly AND DocumentMessage.PopUp) AND (NOT &qShowExpiredOnly OR &qShowExpiredOnly AND CASE WHEN DocumentMessage.CloseToDate <> &qEmptyDate AND DocumentMessage.CloseToDate < &qCurrentDate THEN 32 WHEN DocumentMessage.CloseToDate <> &qEmptyDate AND &qNumberOfDaysToWarnBeforeExpire > 0 AND DocumentMessage.CloseToDate <= DATEADD(&qCurrentDate, DAY, &qNumberOfDaysToWarnBeforeExpire) THEN 31 ELSE 0 END > 0)
